boon.description: with no # or @ effects. Effect: While this blessing is recharging, the target cannot lie, even by omission. He may refuse to answer a question, but if he does answer a question he must provide all relevant details. This blessing recharges at the conclusion of the trial or ceremony or after the target answers 20 questions, whichever comes first.

chaosStar.description: You believe the blessing to have been invoked successfully.

conservative.requirements: In favour. You and/or the target intone an oath over a symbol of law, authority, or Verena. This requires a prepare manoeuvre. Special: The target may voluntarily agree to take the oath. If so, then do not roll for this action: it is automatically successful.
